title: Last Major City
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 5 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 4000; N-1 \leq M \leq 8000; 2\leq K \leq \min(N,\,10); 1 \leq A_i < B_i \leq N; 1 \leq C_i \leq 10^9; One can travel between any two cities by traversing some roads.; All input values are integers.
